thread:
maya: FYI importing redwood-js in a Cloudflare Worker fails: ReferenceError: Buffer is not defined.
ryan: Is that from the CJS main or ESM build?
maya: Looks like main -> dist/index.cjs pulls in 'buffer'.
tomas: CF Workers has no Node globals. We need an edge-targeted ESM build and conditional exports.
benji: Minimal fix: publish an /edge entrypoint and add exports map. Example: `exports['./edge'] = './dist/edge/index.mjs'`.
maya: Tried `import { RedwoodClient } from 'redwood-js/edge'` and worker booted fine. Typings also resolved in VSCode.
ryan: Short-term docs/quickstart required. Long-term: automatic resolver via exports.import + module + types per entry.
tomas: I'll make a small PR to the rollup build to emit dist/edge (lib: ["dom"]) and add edge.d.ts.
devex-bot: npm: redwood-js@0.9.2-edge-patch published to tag 'edge'.
benji: Add CI job to run the edge bundle in Miniflare to prevent regressions. @devex can track backlog.
maya: Awesome, unblocked — thanks!
